shortDescription: AIR Limited, a direct wholly owned subsidiary of AIR Global NASDAQ:AIIR has launched an offering of U.S. Dollar-denominated Rule 144A/Regulation S senior unsecured notes.The notes will be fully and unconditionally guaranteed on a senior basis by AIR Global PLC and select subsidiaries of the issuer…

children: AIR Limited, a direct wholly owned subsidiary of AIR Global
of U.S. Dollar-denominated Rule 144A/Regulation S senior unsecured notes.

The notes will be fully and unconditionally guaranteed on a senior basis by AIR Global PLC and select subsidiaries of the issuer, with final pricing, interest rates, and key commercial terms to be established upon market pricing.

AIR Limited intends to deploy the net proceeds to pay down outstanding balances, interest, and associated fees under its existing term loan and revolving credit facilities. Any remaining funds will support general corporate purposes and cover transaction-related expenses.
The completion of the offering and the planned allocation of proceeds remain subject to market conditions.

title: AIR Global subsidiary launches senior unsecured notes offering
